summary: A US Treasury request-for-quote desk: the same QuoteRequest, Quote, QuoteResponse negotiation as the FX RFQ venue, in a bond desk's vocabulary. Issues by CUSIP with coupon and maturity, levels quoted in 32nds and yield, sized in millions of nominal, settling T+1. A disclosed side is quoted one way; cover and done-away are answered rather than refused. Two clients, a load-ready client, templates, two scenarios that run green, and two load sets of the same round trip — one bursting each phase, one lifting each quote the moment it lands.
